newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Broker to offer Russian power utility certificate.
newsitem.headline: Broker to offer Russian power utility certificate.

text.p: Brokerage house MC Securities said on Wednesday it would issue a certificate on a basket of Russian regional power utilities taking the form of a low-exercise option with cash settlement.
The certificate covers five shares each of Bashkirenergo, Samarenergo, Sverdlovskenergo and Krasnoyarskenergo and 0.10 share of Permenergo.
MC Securities said in a statement the certificate had an indicative issue price of $17.50 and that the fixing date was March 19. It expires on March 20, 1998 and would be settled in Euroclear.
It said there was a minimum trading size of 1,000 units.
